verdict.rationale: The core desktop app runs on the user's own machine. It can be built and run from the repository source with pnpm, and it accepts the user's own OpenAI/Anthropic/other provider keys. However, setup sends the user through a device-code approval at omnirush.ai/console, and the default models come from the account's catalog, so the product still appears to depend on the vendor's hosted service. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting of the backend/service, operation without an omnirush.ai account, an open-source license or self-host deployment docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: omnirush.ai is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects.
pnpm --filter @omnirush/desktop dev      # run the desktop app
You can also add your own OpenAI, Anthropic or other provider keys.
